metadata.name: FuelEconomy.gov Maserati models missing from vPIC
metadata.description: 2026 Maserati models the DOE/EPA FuelEconomy.gov catalog lists as distinct models but vPIC does not list under any model year: GT2 Stradale (record 50273) and MCPURA Spyder (record 50274), verified through the FuelEconomy.gov model-year menu API. The 2026 MCPura itself comes from vPIC.
